title: Marlowe Rewards Courtesy on Delivery Claims Found-Parcel Charges
content:
Loyalty partnership note for Delivery Claims: long-standing Marlowe Rewards members receive a courtesy on a found-parcel charge.

**Courtesy.** The loyalty courtesy depends on the customer's active Marlowe Rewards membership: Platinum, Icon or Atelier held on a membership open for 120 months or more gives 15%; Silver or Gold held on a membership open for 60 months or more gives 10%; any other customer gets no loyalty courtesy.

- Tier: the tier of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active — Marlowe Rewards Platinum, Icon or Atelier; Marlowe Rewards Silver or Gold.
- Months open: months from the enrolment date of that active membership to today.

| Active tier | Months open | Loyalty courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 120 or more | 15% |
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | fewer than 120 | none |
| Silver or Gold | 60 or more | 10% |
| Silver or Gold | fewer than 60 | none |
| Member, or no active membership | any | none |

## Edge cases (hypothetical members)

- Icon, enrolled exactly 120 months ago: 15%. Icon at 119 months: none — the 10% band is for Silver or Gold only.
- Gold at 60 months: 10%. Gold at 59 months: none.
- Gold at 150 months: 10% — the 15% courtesy needs a Platinum, Icon or Atelier tier.
